title: Equal SMA windows are rejected by the strategy itself
purpose: The lab only parses text into types; the strategy's constructor is the authority, and its refusal reaches the user verbatim.

provenance.derived_by: by hand, from the strategy document and the fixture bars; not copied from any run of the tool
sources: docs/STRATEGY_LAB.md section 8 (short_window: at least 1, below long_window) and section 6 (exit status 2)
derivation: short_window 3 is not below long_window 3, which breaks the documented rule
so the configuration is refused before any replay: exit status 2, a configuration error naming both parameters
